author: Codex session 14
body: Smoke014 official execution failed after the intended command-triggered authority retirement; restart and both pilots were not launched. Failed-output diagnostics show the parent transport recording channel_ValueError immediately after owner FINISH and input closure. An unchanged-dev049 deterministic reproduction demonstrates the pending-read/closing-intent race and the same event order, using synthetic CANCEL bytes. The actual historical tail and collapsed exception message are unknown, so the reproduction establishes a code defect without reconstructing absent evidence. Individual namespace retirement diagnostics do not qualify the failed parent transport. A prospective two-phase existing-channel drain is under development with original request, byte, deadline and retirement constraints. The failed attempt remains unassessed with unknown task outcome; fresh complete qualification is required before scoring.
